name: Megyer (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of red, white and red in the ratio 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Megyer (a red shield with a yellow tulip, a heart and ears of grain) between the year 2003 above and the name MEGYER below in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
